Author: Serpens66
Name: Pathfinding
Description: Faster and smarter unit movement: shared group routes, better commands, gate routing, Assassin climbing, formations, command queue and synchronized troop movement.

Changes: Preserve the Pathfinding settings and author rules moved from BugfixesAndQoL in older saves, maps and trails. Newly added routing features stay off for migrated missions. Requires APIShared 0.51.0.
Use shared validation for building lookups; require APIShared 0.49.0. Gameplay rules and settings are unchanged.
Reduce recurring work when checking the map for changes that affect unit paths.
Restore translated formation names and the settings reset button in every supported language.
Avoid temporary allocations while waiting for queued movement and remove an unused deferred-move context that retained old commands.
Keep unchanged gate routing policies cached in normal builds and calculate protected-center placement much faster for deep formations.
Refresh gatehouse reachability between native query passes, including loads and editor work that share the same game timestamp.
Preserve the previous settings when migration files cannot be read or written, including explicit changes made before an import can finish.
Accept multiplayer Assassin climbing and formation commands only from the verified player who controls the affected mode or owns the troop group.
Report BugfixesAndQoL versions older than 1.0.215, which still contain the same movement features.
Prevent unreachable enemies from closing gates anywhere inside the active closing range, including extended ranges and distances measured from the gate center.
First standalone version, built from the movement features of BugfixesAndQoL and MoatMove. Runs alongside BugfixesAndQoL; the old MoatMove test mod must be removed.
